watchlist.missing: Long break of the 1.0966–1.0970 zone. After the spike low at about 1.0954, strong green M5 candles closed above the zone (close beyond, displacement), followed through to about 1.0976, and took out the prior M5 swing high (structure). Price came back into the zone and is holding at 1.0970 (retest). The 6:35am chart shows the EMA 20 (about 1.0968) just crossing above the flat EMA 50, with price above both and RSI at 53. That's a borderline pass, read on M5 not M15. That makes it 5/6 at best, but there's no bullish engulfing or pin bar at the retest, only small two-sided candles, so it stays C. Pricing it doesn't work either: entry about 1.0970 with the SL at about 1.0962 (2–3 pips under the retest swing) and TP at about 1.0977 resistance is roughly 1:1, well under 1:2. The zone has also been crossed both ways several times since last night. Blocked by the FOMC minutes at 11:00am PT.

mistakes: None found. No setups were graded or taken, and nothing was entered before the 11:00am PT FOMC block. This review is based on price action only, not actual OANDA fills. The only price data I could find was a few same-day news snippets, with no intraday candles. xtb.com, tradingnews.com and tradingeconomics.com are blocked in this sandbox, so I can't give the exact sequence of moves after the plan.
lessons: Standing aside looks right. The minutes were hawkish (almost all officials see more hikes, and a couple raised 50bp for December), but news reports say the market had mostly priced that in. EUR/USD dipped from about 1.0980 to 1.0972 on the release, couldn't get past 1.0980, and drifted back toward 1.0960. The intraday low was reported at 1.0968, the lowest since May 2025.

The long idea above 1.0977: the reported 1.0980 high only just clears 1.0977, and price then sold off back through the 1.0966–1.0970 zone. If that was a body close above 1.0977, it was a failed break (C), not a trade. The short idea below 1.0966: price reached about 1.0960–1.0968, but I found no report of it reaching 1.0954 support. A short from a retest of 1.0966 would have needed a stop of about 4 pips to make 1:2, and I can't confirm a clean retest with a trigger. With data this thin, I can't grade either one more precisely.

For tomorrow: EUR/USD is at 2026 lows, about 1.0960–1.0970, with December hike odds reported above 95%. Watch 1.0954 (the overnight spike low) as the next support, and treat the 1.0966–1.0970 zone as resistance now. Please mark the H1/M15 support below 1.0954 so a short break can be checked for 1:2.
review.gradingAudit: No setups were graded. The EUR/USD watchlist C holds up: there was no candle trigger at the retest, R:R to 1.0977 was about 1:1, and the zone had been crossed both ways several times. Every USD pair was also blocked until 11:00am PT. The reports I found describe a small, mostly priced-in dip after the minutes and no clean breakout, so nothing points to a missed A or B. Without intraday candles I can't rule out a short break and retest of 1.0966 between 11:00am and 2:00pm PT.
